html:
An announcement, reposted from the organizer, for EAC 2024, the trade show and conference held on June 21–22, 2024, in Hall E3 of the Suzhou International Expo Center and organized by Enmore Automotive Technology (Shanghai). Its centerpiece for audio is the 3rd International Automotive Audio Innovation Forum. Billed themes include subjective and objective evaluation of in-car audio, immersive cabins, surround sound, high-performance audio chips, and how audio interacts with the cabin space.

The published program opens with a closed-door salon on evaluating and testing in-car audio and lists talks from carmakers including Porsche (its next-generation surround sound system), BYD, NIO, FAW (the Hongqi brand) and Geely, alongside Huawei, iFlytek, Harman Kardon, Dirac, AAC Technologies, Sonavox (objective test methods for in-car sound), Goodix and a range of Chinese audio start-ups. Co-located events include a future-cockpit conference on HMI and user experience, the 10th International Automotive NVH Innovation Forum (with vehicle NVH, ANC/RNC and materials tracks) and a conference on automotive chips, which notes that China’s self-sufficiency in automotive chips roughly doubled between 2020 and 2023, from about 5–6% to about 11%.

The organizer promises more than 3,000 experts from carmakers, over 30,000 visitors, a 40,000 m² exhibition with demo cars, buyer matchmaking, and, for the first time, delegations of overseas carmakers from North America, Europe, the Middle East and Southeast Asia, among them GM, Ford, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volvo, Stellantis, JLR, Renault, VinFast, Toyota, Nissan and Honda.

Reposted on Ziyu Acoustics from an announcement by the organizer, Enmore Automotive Technology.
